Senses.PreferredTarget: the four vine-switch strokes below Jiyun Peak
AlternateTargets: Jiyun Peak's four strokes of the vine
SearchAliases: four cane blows below Jiyun Peak
Senses.Explanation: An allusive case-tag recalling Yangshan's four vine blows to Great Chan Buddha (Da Chanfo) below Jiyun Peak. Gulin Qingmao, Zhenjing Kewen, Wei'an Deran, and Wanru Tongwei each actively redeploy the complete case-tag in verse or instruction.
Senses.Note: This is not a generic count of four vines. It names the four-stroke credential in the inherited Yangshan–Great Chan Buddha case.
